Select compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Source molecule_dictionary, molecule_hierarchy, compound_structures, compound_records, docs, activities, assays, target_dictionary. Join molecule_hierarchy on parent_molregno to find salt forms of CHEMBL3182437. Join compound_structures on molregno for canonical_smiles. Join compound_records on molregno. Join activities on record_id. Join docs on doc_id for pubmed_id_or_doi. Join assays on assay_id for assay_description. Join target_dictionary on tid for target details. Filter parent compound chembl_id equals 'CHEMBL3182437'. Filter target chembl_id equals 'CHEMBL3430885'. Filter standard_type equals 'IC50'. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
